7.1. Необязательная веб-аналитика включа: 7.1. Optional web analytics starts only after choosing Allow analytics. You can decline or change your choice through Analytics settings at the bottom of the page. Declining does not restrict the Service. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals disable collection.
7.2. После согласия в localStorage брауз: 7.2. After consent, random browser and visit identifiers and your choice are stored in browser localStorage for 180 days. The backend stores only hashed identifiers. A visit ends after 30 minutes without page views. Declining clears the browser identifiers and stops future collection.
7.3. Аналитика ORKEN учитывает тип стран: 7.3. ORKEN analytics records page types without individual report or profile addresses, device category, acquisition source and limited UTM tags. Verified registration, diagnostic start and report payment can be linked to a visit. Journal and conversation content, photos, audio, email, passwords, login tokens, full URLs, IP addresses and full User-Agent strings are not written to web analytics tables. No third-party analytics SDKs are used.
7.4. Записи веб-аналитики хранятся до 18: 7.4. Web analytics records are retained for up to 180 days and deleted automatically, with expiry checked every 6 hours. Withdrawing consent stops future collection but does not itself delete previously collected statistics. Contact support about previously collected data. Recording accounts, payments and other operations required to provide the Service does not depend on consent to optional web analytics.
